\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Tensorization}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Products.Tensorization
\section{Overview}
Nonnegative finite coordinate kernels tensorize both pairing bounds and moment-norm contractions. The weights and kernels are explicit and need not be normalized.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Tensorization of pairing estimates]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteTensorization.pair_tensorization}
\leanok
\difficulty{6}
Let $\Omega_i$ be finite sets, $w_i(a)\ge0$ weights, and $k_i(a,b)\ge0$ kernels for $i\in[n]$. For $p,r\ge1$, suppose $\sum_{a,b}k_i(a,b)u(a)v(b)\le\|u\|_{p,w_i}\|v\|_{r,w_i}$ for every coordinate $i$ and real $u,v$. Then $\sum_{x,y}(\prod_i k_i(x_i,y_i))f(x)g(y)\le\|f\|_{p,w}\|g\|_{r,w}$ for all real $f,g$ on $\prod_i\Omega_i$, where $w(x)=\prod_iw_i(x_i)$ and $\|h\|_{s,w}=(\sum_xw(x)|h(x)|^s)^{1/s}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Tensorization of norm contractions]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteTensorization.norm_tensorization}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.norm_le_of_pairing, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteNorms.weighted_holder, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.FiniteTensorization.pair_tensorization}
\difficulty{5}
Let $\Omega_i$ be finite sets, $w_i(a)\ge0$ weights, and $k_i(y,x)\ge0$ kernels for $i\in[n]$. For $p\ge1$ and $q>1$, suppose $\|\sum_xk_i(\,\cdot\,,x)h(x)\|_{q,w_i}\le\|h\|_{p,w_i}$ for every coordinate $i$ and real $h$. Then the product operator $Tf(y)=\sum_x\prod_i k_i(y_i,x_i)f(x)$ satisfies $\|Tf\|_{q,w}\le\|f\|_{p,w}$ for every real $f$ on $\prod_i\Omega_i$, with $w(x)=\prod_iw_i(x_i)$ and $\|h\|_{s,w}=(\sum_xw(x)|h(x)|^s)^{1/s}$.
\end{theorem}
